Multiple Entrance Exam Seat Allotment Results Released

Results for the second round of seat allotment for several entrance examinations have been released. These include the MAH MBA CET 2026, NEET SS 2025, and BCECE 2026. Candidates can check their admission and allocation details on the respective official websites. The NEET SS Round 2 allotment result was released on the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) website, while the BCECE 2026 result was published on the Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board's site.
